name: oydodo-skills
description: Eighteen curated skills for philosophical judgment, long-term decision navigation, domain modeling, CodeGraph repository navigation, evidence research, prototyping, lean coding, hard-bug diagnosis, agent-instruction quality, manual session retros, visual reporting, and technical writing.

interface.longDescription: Philosophical foundation; independent judgment; crux-first reasoning; Wayfinder decision maps; grilling; domain modeling; optional local CodeGraph exploration; evidence research; lightweight prototyping; figure-first visual reports and architecture diagrams; requirements interviews; coding simplicity; hard-bug diagnosis; writing-for-agents; user-invoked retro; and three technical writing skills.
defaultPrompt: Review this decision and challenge its assumptions when necessary.
Choose the decisive factor in this architecture tradeoff.
Write a README that explains why, how, and expected results.
Use Wayfinder to map open decisions, their blockers, and the fog of war in this multi-session project.
